No normalized aggregation equation or validation-mean weighting is supplied.
MGB fit subset and summary-statistics transport remain unspecified; no leakage-free assertion.
EMR dimension conflict remains: Results19 plusCXR versus Methods21.
Best-local candidate/score pairing, reevaluation timing and exact client/dropout policy remain unspecified.
Fixed parameters by zero learning rate do not prove all BN state frozen.
CDH best global is supported; MVH/NCH exact checkpoint unknown.
Original a0–1 scale versus b displayed score scale is not normalized or reconstructed here.
Local custody, SSL and investigated partial updates do not establish formal DP, secure aggregation or homomorphic encryption.

original_b_quantitative_scope.axes: Horizontal CORISK24 score (visible roughly40–100); vertical patient count; stable and deteriorated distributions overlaid. No digitization or plot reconstruction.
original_b_quantitative_scope.threshold_A_caption: Illustrative safe-discharge threshold: reported99.5%NPV; model positive is LFO or above (risk>=0.25); reference negative is discharge without readmission, reference positive is readmission for treatment.
original_b_quantitative_scope.threshold_B_caption: Illustrative ICU-admission threshold: reported50.3%PPV; model positive is MV or above (risk>=0.75); reference positive is MV requirement or death, reference negative is survival without MV.
original_b_quantitative_scope.interpretation_limit: Two predictive-value calculations use different reference definitions. Source caption proposes analogous EXAM use but does not establish a prospective intervention benefit. The displayed b score scale and a0–1 scale are not independently reconciled; no silent normalization or threshold transfer.
